title: Dynamics of Erased Distinctions
summary: A living synthesis of the project’s current view of coarse-graining: closure tracks which distinctions remain causally relevant, how erased distinctions return to visibility, and when representation repair must restore them.
thesis: Groovy Commutator studies the dynamics of distinctions erased by a representation.

title: Dimensional Closure and the Commutator Lift
summary: Loop revision has an exact transverse support cost, and replication multiplies intervention cost while preserving edited dynamics. Native 3D actions offer additional outcomes on the declared finite grids. The frozen audit is complete; the agreed issue burndown is underway.
thesis: When two dynamical paths fail to commute, represent the disagreement as a new coordinate and ask whether the enlarged representation closes.

title: Invariants Across Representation Contracts
summary: First audit complete: reflection preserves the commutator classification, derivative closure, and all local-cap budgets; complement conjugation makes the native commutator covariant exactly for self-dual rules and shifts cap radii beyond a frozen bound that was wrong. The program declares admissible changes of interpreter, what each transports, and what each costs.
thesis: Which properties of a represented dynamics survive a declared change of representation contract, after transporting what must be transported, and at what cost?
